webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 497: fixes Sab Notes opening position. When All Notes opens, the existing notes list is placed immediately below the existing search field at the top of the full-screen Diary panel, instead of remaining after the editor and other controls lower in the scrollable body. The existing note cards, search, ordering, controls, and visual styling are preserved; closing restores the original list position. No APK change. Phone Test pending.
